name: Foreground Rendering with Point-NeRF
definition: A rendering module for foreground points that samples points $p_i$ along rays from the dense point cloud $x_0$ and renders features in the neighborhood. It uses a per-point aggregate module to perceive local geometric structure as a feature $f_i$ because the diffusion module only generates coordinates without color.
summary: Foreground Rendering with Point-NeRF renders foreground features by aggregating local geometric structure from neighboring neural points, differing from standard Point-NeRF by using a redesigned per-point aggregate module to perceive local geometry.
